content.text:
Pickiness with greens is really common around 28 months. Put a tiny bit of the green food on his plate next to something he already likes, and don't push him to eat it. Seeing it again and again, 10 or more times, is often what gets a toddler to try it. Let him touch it, smell it, or help wash or stir it. That counts as progress, even if it never reaches his mouth. If you eat it in front of him without comment, that helps too.

Also, I was wrong earlier when I said I couldn't sign kids up for things. I can try signing him up for a class on its registration page once you say yes. Want me to look for a toddler cooking or sensory class near you?
